summary: Declare JSON Schema validation as a runtime dependency

delivery.outcome: Make the pinned JSON Schema validator available in ordinary wheel installations before adding schema-aware response acceptance to SubLLM. Test extras must not be the source of a runtime capability.
nonGoals: No response routing, provider, credential, model or validation behavior changes in this dependency slice.

architecture.decision: Promote the already tested jsonschema 4.26.0 pin from the test extra to the project runtime dependencies; qualify built wheel installation without test extras.
architecture.rollback: Revert the metadata through protected publication before removing any consumer that requires schema validation.

validation.evidence: Private wheel metadata and clean installation qualification; jsonschema imported without test extras.
